title: A one-parameter family of local-time conditioned processes : the generalized Brownian burglars
summary: We construct and characterize the one-parameter family of real-valued processes that allow to recover the law of a Brownian loop-soup of any intensity on the real line conditionally on its occupation time field. These processes generalize the Brownian burglar constructed by Warren and Yor (that corresponds to our process in the limiting case where the intensity vanishes and there is just one Brownian motion).
